blocks.text: The Asian Games in Japan were facing more accusations of poor organization Friday with a world champion gymnast “totally exhausted,” the public drafted in to rescue stranded athletes and South Korea lodging a complaint about a Japanese warlord. The continent’s premier sporting spectacle opens in Nagoya and Aichi prefecture on Saturday, but the build-up has been soured by several issues. READ: Asian Games 2026 at Aichi-Nagoya, Japan: By the numbers That includes a shortage of rooms for the more than 17,000 athletes and officials — a bigger number than the Olympics.
